Front Matter

0.5-preface 0.5-preface

How do we safely grant autonomy to commodity intelligence?

This is a book about engineering: what engineering becomes when reasoning capacity is abundant.

MAGE: Model-Based Agentic Engineering

*Agentic engineering* is the engineering of systems and environments in which autonomous agents perform consequential work.

Why MAGE? Why Models?

One way to understand MAGE is as a classical software-engineering move: **add a level of indirection.**[^indirection] Conventional engineering has long separated the engineering of an artifact from its physical realization.

The origins of MAGE

MAGE grew out of an engineering problem I encountered while building DocAble, a service for making documents accessible to people with disabilities.

Who this book is for

This book is for software engineers who want to understand what changes when implementation can be delegated to capable agents.

0.4-the-books-language 0.4-the-books-language

Engineering

**Authority.** Who is entitled to exercise engineering judgment: to decide what a system must do, permit or refuse an action, and answer for the result?

Software Agents

**Agent.** An AI system that pursues an open-ended or underspecified task through multiple steps, exercising judgment about what to do next and using tools in response to intermediate results.

MAGE

**Agentic engineering.** The engineering of systems and environments in which autonomous agents perform consequential work.

Lesson4.2-one-problem-many-models 4.2-one-problem-many-models

Modeling Memory Residency

(no topic sentence — opens on a non-paragraph block)

One Document, One Worker

DocAble originally treated an entire document as one unit of execution.

Dividing the Document among Workers

My first response was to introduce ChunkWorker, which divided a document into page ranges ([ref:interlude-execution-unit], panel b).

Separating Document Structure from Media

Dividing documents into page ranges reduced the amount of content each worker processed, but did not remove the underlying dependence on document size.

Remove Media from the Working Set

The memory problem came from coupling document structure to media residency: total media size increased the worker's persistent working set even though most remediation operations needed only the document's structural skeleton.

Model the Cause, Not Just the Symptom

Measuring peak memory tells us how much memory the worker consumed.

Memory as an Obligation for Subsequent Changes

I could now investigate ways to reduce latency and cost, but the new designs still had to satisfy the memory obligation.

Production Economics

**Runtime and inference cost.** Median elapsed time across all 63 attempts, including the failed attempt, was 1.36 minutes.

Limits of the Case

Lesson5.4-other-agentic-software-factories 5.4-other-agentic-software-factories

Cloudflare

Cloudflare operates a global network that provides security, performance, and connectivity services for Internet applications.

Spotify

Spotify operates a music and audio streaming service supported by many independently developed software components.

Shopify

Shopify develops a commerce platform through which merchants operate online stores, manage transactions, and run their businesses.

Uber

Uber operates a platform for transportation and delivery, supported by software services that coordinate users, providers, transactions, and real-time operations.

Amazon

Amazon develops software for commerce and cloud computing, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), whose products depend on large, continuously evolving software systems.

GitLab

GitLab develops a software-development platform that brings source control, code review, continuous integration, and deployment workflows into a common environment.

Siemens

Siemens develops industrial technologies and engineering software used to design, simulate, manufacture, and maintain physical products.

What the Factories Share, and Where They Differ

The four factory questions reveal different arrangements for organizing agentic production, not stages along a common path toward autonomy.
